samples.text_head: NAV and Zipline Valuation Summary by AI BETA Close X Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust PLC announced an increase in the valuation of its Zipline holding, which has consequently raised the company's Net Asset Value to 1,648.93p as of 16 September 2026. This valuation adjustment means Zipline now represents 3.8% of the company's total assets, a significant increase from 1.8% as of 31 July 2026. Disclaimer* Scottish Mortgage Inv Tst PLC 17 September 2026 This announcement contains inside information for the purposes of Article 7 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation. Upon the publication of this announcement via a Regulatory Information Service, this inside information is now considered to be in the public domain. Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust PLC (SMT) ("The Company") Legal Entity Identifier: 213800G37DCS3Q9IJM38 Update on Net Asset Value and adjustment to the valuation of Zipline Today, the Board has been advised by the Manager of an increase in the valuation of the Company's holding in Zipline in line with its policy for valuing private company investments. This has been reflected in the Net Asset Value of the Company which as at close of business on 16 September 2026 stands at 1,648.93p. Following that adjustment in valuation the proportion of the Company's total assets made up by Zipline stands at 3.8% at close of business on 16 September 2026, compared with 1.8% on 31 July 2026. Baillie Gifford & Co Limited 17 September 2026
